description: Functional specifications/files: adapter.ex and transport/req_client.ex; optional policy branch inside existing send/edit lifecycle. Strict upload all planned groups before any post/update. Continue retains confirmed uploads/files after preparation/upload failure. Preserve old behavior when option absent. Tests to add first: mixed/all rejection, later group upload failure no strict publication, partial batch results, no duplicate upload, edit policy, partial/uncertain publication, default compatibility. Branches: prep/upload/create/edit/exception, ordered identity/report accuracy. Mocking: async FakeTransport, HTTP edge transport tests existing seams. Documentation: adapter contract at final step. Action reuse: extend existing private upload/planning/publication helpers and delivery_report, transport returns partial uploaded results only for explicit policy; no public upload API, no ZAQ types/callbacks. Credentials and transport stay existing opts; no retries.
title: [zaq-ucc] Enforce Mattermost attachment policy inside existing delivery
